metadata.title: Urban New Jack Swing Album Aesthetic

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast urban scene featuring three figures in 1990s streetwear posing against a concrete graffiti-covered barrier, framed by bold, eclectic typography that utilizes vertical stacking and collage-style cutouts.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical text on the left balances the horizontal spread of the figures.
The bright white sky creates a high-key background that isolates the subjects.
Rough concrete textures contrast with the clean, bold graphic overlays.
The central figure's dark clothing acts as a vertical anchor between the two more colorful figures.
coreInvariants: Eclectic mix of serif and distressed block typography

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three full-body figures positioned mid-ground, spanning the horizontal center of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large vertical text on the far left and the bright pink collage text at the bottom center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the vertical text on the left, moves across the faces of the three subjects, and drops down to the pink collage title.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white negative space in the upper half of the frame provides breathing room for the large header text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Neutral grays and whites from the concrete and sky.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and dark leathers in the clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant magenta/pink in the bottom text and bright red in the left figure's jacket.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value (bright) background with medium-to-high saturation accents in the foreground elements.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to primary-adjacent accents (Red, Pink, Green)

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold slab serifs and distressed sans-serifs
letterConstructionRules: Jagged, 'cut-out' paper edges for secondary titles
Heavy drop shadows or outlines to separate text from busy backgrounds
characterSpecificRedesigns: O-characters in the collage text are stylized as horizontal capsules or pill shapes.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of rigid, formal slab serifs with chaotic, DIY-style collage lettering.

preserve: Vertical orientation of the left-side text
The magenta/pink color for the bottom title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif weight of the primary branding.
Captures the distressed, cut-and-paste aesthetic of the bottom title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A wide-angle photo of three men in 1990s urban streetwear (leather jackets, baggy jeans, boots) leaning against a low concrete wall with faint graffiti. The background is a bright, blown-out white sky. Ground is gravelly dirt.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large black slab-serif text vertically on the left edge with a thin yellow outline. Add a collage-style title at the bottom center using magenta letters on individual white jagged rectangles.

verificationChecks: Is the left-side text vertically stacked?
Does the bottom text look like it was cut out of paper?
Are the 90s fashion elements (hats, oversized jackets) present?

adjustableVariables: Specific typeface for the collage text
postGenerationChecks: Text does not obscure the faces of the subjects.
The magenta color is vibrant and pops against the gray concrete.
The vertical text on the left feels integrated into the frame edge.
The overall image maintains a high-contrast, 'street' feel.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Streetwear Subject + Concrete/Graffiti Midground + Blown-out Sky + Vertical Slab-Serif Branding + Collage-Style Title Overlay.
